description: Free, no key. Returns ready-to-open search links on the big retailers and brand stores that fit a product query (brand named in the query first, then category specialists, then general retailers). Use it to go straight to the right stores, or when search_products finds nothing.

query.description: What the shopper wants, e.g. 'wide fit hiking boots'.

region.description: Put retailers in this country first.

name: find_retailers
